d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.

Tivoli Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort and Avani Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort are looking for passionate, dynamic, and service-driven individuals to join our growing teams. Set along Bahrain’s stunning west coast, our resorts offer an inspiring work environment where luxury hospitality meets warm Arabian hospitality.

We offer exciting career opportunities, professional development, and the chance to be part of two internationally renowned hotel brands. If you are motivated, guest-focused, and eager to grow your career in hospitality, we would love to hear from you.
Be part of something exceptional. Be part of our team.

We are seeking a highly experienced, strategic, and detail-oriented Director of Finance to lead the pre-opening and launch financial operations of Tivoli Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort and Avani Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort.

This key executive role is responsible for establishing robust financial controls, systems, and reporting structures while partnering with the Hotel Manager and senior leadership team to ensure strong financial governance, compliance, and long-term profitability from opening day.

r: Lead all pre-opening financial planning and setup, including budgeting, forecasting, financial systems, and internal controls.
Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and SOPs in line with brand standards and local regulations.
Prepare and manage pre-opening budgets, opening balance sheets, and capital expenditure tracking.
Oversee all accounting, finance, procurement, cost control, and payroll functions for both properties.
Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting, including monthly financial statements, forecasts, and variance analysis.
Partner closely with department heads to provide financial guidance, cost control measures, and performance analysis.
Ensure full compliance with statutory requirements, audits, tax regulations, and brand financial policies.
Support the Hotel Manager and ownership with strategic financial insights, cash flow management, and decision-making.
Establish and lead the finance team, including recruitment, training, and development during the pre-opening phase.
Implement strong controls to safeguard hotel assets, cash handling, inventory, and purchasing processes.

This role is ideal for a pre-opening finance leader with strong hotel financial expertise, commercial awareness, and the ability to build solid financial foundations for a successful luxury resort operation.

d: 🌟 We're Hiring: Financial Planning Analyst / Senior Financial Advisor / Cost Control Specialist
📍 Location: Jid Hafs, Capital Governorate, Bahrain(Remote)

We are a business-focused organization committed to strengthening financial performance, improving resource allocation, and supporting sustainable growth. Through financial analysis, strategic planning, and effective cost management, we aim to help organizations make informed decisions and maintain strong financial discipline.

We are seeking an experienced finance professional to support financial planning, performance analysis, and cost management initiatives. This role combines analytical expertise with practical financial insight to help evaluate business performance, identify financial risks, and improve operational efficiency.

Working remotely with flexible part-time hours, you will collaborate with management and relevant departments to prepare financial forecasts, assess expenditure, review financial results, and provide recommendations that support business objectives.
Prepare and review financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and performance reports.
Analyze financial results to identify trends, variances, and improvement opportunities.
Monitor operating costs, expenditure patterns, and budget utilization.
Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support business planning.
Evaluate cost structures and recommend practical cost optimization strategies.
Provide financial insights and recommendations to support management decisions.
Review departmental budgets and assess performance against financial targets.
Support cash flow planning, resource allocation, and financial risk assessments.
Collaborate with finance, operations, and business teams on financial initiatives.
Monitor key financial indicators and contribute to continuous improvement in financial controls.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in financial planning, financial analysis, or cost management preferred.
Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and cost analysis.
Knowledge of financial modelling, variance analysis, and performance measurement.
Familiarity with cost control methods and financial planning processes.
Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial reporting tools, and data analysis.
Ability to interpret financial information and communicate practical recommendations.
Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Ability to manage priorities independently and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.
Flexible part-time working hours with a fully remote arrangement.
Competitive compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
Opportunities to contribute to financial planning and business performance initiatives.
Exposure to strategic financial analysis and cost optimization projects.
Professional development in financial management, forecasting, and business advisory.
A collaborative environment that values analytical thinking, accountability, and continuous improvement.
